title: Flying Saucers International, Issue No. 24, July 1966 cover with saucer photo
description: Cover of "Flying Saucers International," the "Official Journal of the Amalgamated Flying Saucer Clubs of America, Inc.," Issue No. 24, July 1966, labeled "SPECIAL AFSCA THIRD NATIONAL FLYING SAUCER CONVENTION ISSUE" and priced 50c. The dominant image is a photograph of a disc-shaped object with banded rim hovering in a cloudy sky above a line of conifer trees. Handwritten FBI file notations (100-36998) and declassification and serial stamps appear on the cover.
